questions.question: Dr. Karim asks Dr. Leila: 'What is the first step to set up a practice?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The business plan is the first step. It will allow you to visualize your project, anticipate costs, and convince banks.' Karim: 'I'll get to work!'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to evaluate the profitability of a practice?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The break-even point is the point where your revenue covers your expenses. It's the goal to achieve in the first months.' Karim: 'I will calculate my break-even point.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What are the operating costs of a practice?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Operating costs are multiple: rent, salaries, supplies, insurance, maintenance, etc. You must anticipate them all.' Karim: 'I will list all my expenses.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to finance my practice setup?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Solutions are varied: bank loans, practice setup assistance programs, micro-loans, personal savings.' Karim: 'I will explore all options.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What should a business plan contain?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'A good business plan contains the budget forecast, growth forecasts, development strategy, and market analysis.' Karim: 'I will prepare a complete business plan.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'What are the mandatory administrative procedures?' Leila replies:
options: Registration with ONMD, CNSS, taxes, lease
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Procedures are numerous: registration with ONMD, CNSS affiliation, obtaining a business license, lease registration, etc.' Karim: 'I will make a list of all procedures.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What is the average cost of a dental practice in Morocco?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The average cost is between 600,000 and 1,000,000 DH, depending on equipment and location.' Karim: 'I will plan a significant budget.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to choose the location of my practice?' Leila replies:
options: A location with good visibility and accessibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Visibility and accessibility are key criteria. A good location allows you to attract patients more easily.' Karim: 'I will study the location carefully.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What are the advantages of assistantship before setting up?' Leila replies:
options: Gain experience without the overhead costs
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Assistantship allows you to gain experience, build a patient base, and prepare your practice setup with peace of mind.' Karim: 'I will consider assistantship.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to set my fees?' Leila replies:
options: Based on CNSS and the local market
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Fees should be in line with CNSS agreed tariffs and the local market.' Karim: 'I will study the tariffs practiced.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'How to manage my first years?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The first years are demanding. You need to be patient, learn from your mistakes, and celebrate small victories.' Karim: 'I will take my time.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'What is the importance of a professional network?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'A professional network is essential for advice, recommendations, and support.' Karim: 'I will develop my network.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'How to evaluate the potential patient base?' Leila replies:
options: By estimating the number of patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Demographic analysis of the neighborhood gives you an idea of the potential patient base.' Karim: 'I will study the demographics.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'What are the risks of a quick practice setup?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'A quick setup without preparation can lead to financial stress and a lack of serenity.' Karim: 'I will prepare well.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What is the importance of practice equipment?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Good equipment is essential for quality of care and patient comfort.' Karim: 'I will invest in quality equipment.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to handle financial unexpected events?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'A precautionary savings allows you to face unexpected events without stress.' Karim: 'I will build a precautionary savings.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What is the average loan repayment period?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The average loan period for practice setup is 5 to 7 years.' Karim: 'I will plan for a 7-year period.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to choose practice management software?' Leila replies:
options: Software adapted to the practice's needs
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The choice should be based on the specific needs of the practice: appointment management, invoicing, accounting.' Karim: 'I will compare software.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What is the importance of continuing education?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Continuing education is essential to stay up to date and offer the best care.' Karim: 'I will train regularly.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'How to manage competition?' Leila replies:
options: By offering superior quality of care
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'The best way to manage competition is to offer superior quality of care and a trusting relationship.' Karim: 'I will focus on quality.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'What are the signs of a successful practice?' Leila replies:
options: A loyal patient base and steady growth
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'A successful practice is recognized by a loyal patient base, steady growth, and a good reputation.' Karim: 'I will aim for loyalty.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'What are the advantages of associating with a colleague?' Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Association allows you to share expenses, skills, and stress.' Karim: 'I will consider an association.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim asks: 'How to prepare for retirement from the beginning of your career?' Leila replies:
options: Wait until the end of your career
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'It's never too early to prepare for retirement. Saving regularly is essential.' Karim: 'I will start saving now.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim wonders: 'What are patients' rights?' Leila replies:
options: Right to information and informed consent
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Patients have the right to clear information and to give informed consent.' Karim: 'I will always inform my patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim, after mastering the aspects of practice setup with Leila, says: 'I'm ready to launch!' Leila concludes: 'Mastering practice setup is...'
options: The foundation of a serene career
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila explains: 'Mastering practice setup is the foundation of a serene career.' Karim: 'I will launch with confidence.'
